method: R1 A navigation site is a routerLink attribute or binding, or a Router.navigate / navigateByUrl call, in a file under the application directory; test and spec files are excluded. navigate([], ...) that only changes the query string of the current screen is excluded and recorded with its reason.

R2 The screens a site fires from are the screens whose routed component renders, transitively through template element selectors, the component whose file holds the site. What the shell renders around the primary outlet is on every screen.
R3 A site inside a service is attributed to the screens from which the enclosing method can actually be called, found by searching for its callers, not to every component that injects the service.
R4 Each site records its target and a one-line reason; sites whose screens cannot be determined from the source are listed separately with the reason, not guessed.
R5 This reference was built by an AI assistant from the application sources alone, blind to the analyzer's output; it is not independent of the analysis's relations, which it applies by hand.

Shell: ShellLayoutComponent (@alfresco/adf-core/shell, not in the source tree) is placed by provideShellRoutes(CONTENT_LAYOUT_ROUTES) under the root router-outlet in app.component.html; the sidenav (app.layout.sidenav) and the header user menu (features.header in app.extensions.json) are shell content, hence ALL.

Routes: CONTENT_LAYOUT_ROUTES (aca-content.routes.ts), CONTENT_ROUTES (preview/s/:id, view), FOLDER_RULES_ROUTES (rules; also lazily under nodes/:nodeId). Secondary-outlet 'viewer' routes are not screens.
